name: Nature (submission approximation)
description: Nature-family submission format approximated with the standard article class (Nature's own class is not needed for initial submission): 12pt double-spaced, 1in margins, superscript numeric citations via naturemag.bst, unnumbered section headings, line numbers on. Nature caps the main text tightly — the limits lint warns past ~200-word abstract / 4500-word body / 50 references / 8 figures. Swap to Springer Nature's class only at acceptance.
